rules: No audit lead is promoted automatically.
Ordinary Core logic and source-status, motivational, prescriptive, evaluative, or bare source-association modality do not become non-Core G1 occurrences.

Load-bearing source-local operations, equations, decompositions, representations, actions, comparisons, constraints, and side conditions are conserved without assigning conventional mathematical categories.
Exact source/relation/argument spans from the validated complete adjudication supersede earlier draft spans when the admission class agrees.

The sole accept/reject conflict with the earlier partial review is L-SSC-047; it is rejected because 'claims no free parameters at that level' is a source-level/core-expressible status claim and supplies no lower non-Core operation behavior.
No textbook semantics, primitive proposal, candidate basis label, or W/L correspondence is introduced.
